cohort: Women giving birth at 28 weeks gestation or greater at Mizan-Tepi University Teaching Hospital, with a history of prior cesarean birth (n=49)
finding: Almost one-third of women with a prior cesarean birth attempted trial of labor after cesarean, and those who were successful were more likely to have been more cervically dilated on admission.
mod_finding: Among women with a history of prior cesarean birth, 65.1% with one prior cesarean and 80% with two prior cesareans had a repeat cesarean birth.
